title: zieria cytisoides var. involucrata
intro: Zieria cytisoides var. involucrata, commonly known as the East Coast Zieria, is a plant species native to eastern Australia. It is valued for its therapeutic properties and potential health benefits. The plant is reported to have analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which may help alleviate pain, reduce inflammation, and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of Zieria cytisoides var. involucrata include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
